name: Acampamento da Fronteira de Estuário
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: exclusive terrain illustration for fantasy TCG card "Acampamento da Fronteira de Estuário". Scene: frontier encampment beneath old ruined arches, tidewater carrying a sealed spell tome toward archive. Belongs to the Arquivos das Marés, a coastal medieval scholarly civilization. Evoke its effect visually: Gera 1 mana de Água nas regras normais de geração de terrenos. Uma vez no seu turno, se uma construção sua estiver neste terreno, pague 2 manas genéricas: coloque um Feitiço do seu cemitério no fundo do grimório. O controlador do terreno usa esta habilidade.. Treat mechanics as inspiration only, never draw game symbols or words. Refined detailed medieval oil painting with rich visible brushwork, realistic fantasy architecture, convincing atmospheric depth, soft dramatic blue magical light, natural sea and stone colours. Each scene is a unique landscape/place. Horizontal 4:3, central crop-safe focal architecture, full bleed painting. No lettering, text, numbers, UI, frames, borders, signatures, logos, or watermarks.
inspection: Inspected individually: unique coastal medieval terrain tied to card, rich oil-paint brushwork, blue magical lighting, depth and crop-safe focal place; no text/UI/frame/signature/watermark.
